Method of Attack: Dependency repository hijacking (RepoJacking) where attacker registers old username and repository names to serve malicious code
Injecting malicious code via dependency fetch in install.sh script
Attack Vector: Malicious repository registration replacing renamed or transferred repositories
npm install command in build instructions and install.sh script
Indicators of Compromise: Lyft's install.sh script fetching ZIP archive from vulnerable repository
Newly registered repositories with names 'YesGraph' and 'Dominus' replacing old repos
